gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 新增未授权灰度或功能开关
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 删除灰度/开关分支，默认直接按最终行为全量实现（除非需求明确授权兼容开关）。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in production code/config of this git diff (ignore `-` lines and unit tests). Does the diff introduce a feature flag, gray-release toggle, A/B experiment switch, or config/env toggle to gate new behavior?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Adds a feature flag, rollout percentage, gray switch, or env/config toggle gating old vs new behavior.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Direct implementation, normal business config, error fallback on missing external service, or test-only code.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 硬编码真实密钥或凭据
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 立即移除硬编码密钥/密码/私钥，改从 macOS Keychain 或本机忽略配置读取，并轮换已暴露凭据。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in non-test files of this git diff. Does the diff hardcode a real API key, secret token, private key PEM block, or plaintext password/credential?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Contains a real-looking secret key, bearer token, private key, or hardcoded account password in non-test files.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Reads secrets from Keychain/env/config files, uses obvious dummy placeholders in tests (e.g. 'test-key'), or has no secrets.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 在远程服务器执行命令
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 移除 ssh/scp/rsync 远端命令或 kubectl exec / 远端 docker 调用，改走 CI/CD 或把命令交用户执行。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in production code, scripts, and CI config of this git diff (ignore tests, docs, and unchanged context). Does the change introduce a NEW non-CI code path or script that executes commands on a remote server via `ssh`, `scp`, `rsync`, `kubectl exec`, remote `docker -H`/`docker context`, or cloud host shell run-command APIs (e.g. AWS SSM RunCommand, Aliyun Cloud Assistant)? Standard CI/CD pipeline configuration (`.gitlab-ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/*`) orchestrating or reusing the repository's existing deployment scripts, non-remote edits to existing CI deploy scripts, CDN cache refresh CLI/API calls, and standard `git`/`glab`/HTTP API calls are ALLOWED and NOT violations.
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Newly added production/local/helper script or code outside CI pipeline orchestration directly invokes ssh, scp, rsync remote execution, kubectl exec, remote docker -H, or cloud host shell run-command APIs, or adds a local entrypoint bypassing CI/CD to execute remote server commands.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: CI/CD config (`.gitlab-ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/*`) adding or updating protected/manual jobs that call existing repo deploy scripts, non-remote edits to existing CI deploy scripts, CDN cache refresh (e.g. `aliyun cdn RefreshObjectCaches`), local tar/zip/cp/node commands, standard git/glab/HTTP API calls, or lint/rule prose.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 对 main 分支开启自动合并
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 禁止对 main 目标分支设置 auto_merge / merge_when_pipeline_succeeds / glab mr merge --auto。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in code/scripts of this git diff (ignore lint rules and tests). Does the code enable auto-merge (`auto_merge=true`, `merge_when_pipeline_succeeds`, `glab mr merge --auto`) targeting `main`?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Enables automatic merge or merge-when-pipeline-succeeds on a merge request targeting main.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Manual/immediate merge after checks, MRs targeting non-main branches, or rule text forbidding auto-merge.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 开发者运行日志使用了非英文
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 将 console.*/logger.*/logging.*/log(...) 等开发者运行日志改为英文；面向用户的文案、评论和报错保持中文。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in production code of this git diff (ignore tests, comments, docstrings, UI strings, issue/chat messages, and user-facing CLI errors). Does production code emit Chinese text inside developer runtime logging calls (`log(...)`, `logger.*`, `logging.*`, `console.log/warn/error`)?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Added developer runtime log statements output Chinese characters.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Runtime logs are in English, or Chinese text only appears in comments, UI text, user-facing messages/errors, or tests.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 在仓库根目录落盘临时测试截图或录屏
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 改写到 tempfile 临时目录或受控任务目录，不在仓库根目录遗留 .png/.mp4 调试文件。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in this git diff. Does code or a test write temporary screenshots, videos, or debug dumps directly into the repository root directory?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Writes `.png`, `.jpg`, `.mp4`, `.mov`, or debug dump files directly to repo root relative paths.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Uses tempfile/tmp directories, dedicated state/artifact folders, or writes no root artifacts.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 删改或跳过既有测试断言以求过测
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 核对是否未经批准删除回归断言、添加 skip 或放宽通过标准。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect test file changes in this git diff. Does the diff delete existing regression assertions, mark existing tests as skipped (`.skip`, `@unittest.skip`), or weaken expected thresholds just to make failing tests pass?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Skips existing tests, deletes meaningful assertions without replacement, or loosens assertions to hide a bug.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Adds new tests, updates fixtures to match an intentional spec change, or leaves existing assertions intact.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 新增冗长废话注释或英文代码注释
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 代码注释统一用精炼中文短句，只写原因、边界与风险，删掉复述代码字面动作的空话注释。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` code comments in production files of this git diff (ignore Jev English prompt strings). Does the diff add verbose tutorial-style comments, restate obvious code mechanics ('increment i', 'initialize variable'), or write code comments in English instead of concise Chinese?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Adds English code comments or long filler comments that merely restate what the next line obviously does.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Uses concise Chinese comments explaining non-obvious why/constraints, or has self-explanatory code without filler comments.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 手拼旧版 GitLab 上传附件路径
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 使用 upload-media.py 返回的 markdown（/uploads/...）与 web_url（/-/project/<id>/uploads/...），禁止手拼 /<ns>/<proj>/uploads/。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in code/scripts of this git diff (ignore warning docs and tests). Does the code manually construct GitLab attachment URLs using `/<namespace>/<project>/uploads/...` instead of `/-/project/<id>/uploads/...`?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Manually constructs `<host>/<namespace>/<project>/uploads/...` URLs that 404 on GitLab.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 绕过 task-record.py 直接裸发 GitLab 评论
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 任务进度、待办与交付评论统一经 scripts/task-record.py note 发送，保证免打扰与状态同步。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in workflow/helper scripts of this git diff (excluding `task-record.py`, `gitlab-inbox.py`, and tests). Does new code invoke `glab issue note` or POST directly to GitLab `/issues/<iid>/notes` bypassing `task-record.py`?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Added code outside task-record.py/gitlab-inbox.py posts issue comments directly via glab/API.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Uses task-record.py, modifies task-record.py/gitlab-inbox.py itself, or does not post GitLab issue comments.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 在主路径静默吞掉未知异常
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 收窄捕获的异常类型，补充降级日志或显式错误返回，避免空 except/catch 掩盖故障。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in production code of this git diff. Does the code catch broad `Exception` / bare `except:` / empty `catch {}` on a core business path and silently ignore it without logging, fallback explanation, or re-raising?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Broad bare catch/except silently swallows unexpected runtime bugs on a core path with no rationale.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Catches specific expected errors (e.g. JevUnavailableError, OSError on optional cache), logs/degrades intentionally, or propagates errors.

gate4_semantic_lint.title_zh: 将真实窗口验收降级为无头模拟或纯静态截图
gate4_semantic_lint.fix_hint_zh: 前端/Electron 真机验收必须保留真实窗口操作与 .mp4 过程录屏，不用 jsdom 或静态截图顶替。
gate4_semantic_lint.instructions_en: Inspect ONLY newly added `+` lines in frontend acceptance or workflow files of this git diff. Does the diff replace required real-browser/Electron video acceptance with jsdom, curl/static HTML scraping, or screenshot-only checks?
gate4_semantic_lint.true_en: Substitutes real browser/Electron video acceptance with jsdom, headless scraping, or static screenshots.
gate4_semantic_lint.false_en: Normal unit tests, backend scripts, or preserves real-browser/Electron `.mp4` acceptance.

gate5_media_guard.title_zh: 画面暴露明文密码或密钥
gate5_media_guard.error_zh: 检测到画面疑似暴露明文密码或密钥（置信度 {prob:.0%}），已拒绝上传：{file_name}；请遮挡或避开凭据后重录
gate5_media_guard.instructions_en: Does the attached image visibly expose plaintext passwords, API secret keys, bearer tokens, private keys, or a credential list file (ignore masked dots `••••••`, normal usernames/emails, and public URLs)?
gate5_media_guard.true_en: Plaintext password, API secret/token, private key, or credential sheet is readable on screen.
gate5_media_guard.false_en: No plaintext secrets or passwords visible (masked password fields and normal UI data are safe).

gate5_media_guard.title_zh: 画面为纯空白页或未就绪崩溃页
gate5_media_guard.error_zh: 检测到画面疑似纯空白页或未就绪崩溃页（置信度 {prob:.0%}），已拒绝上传：{file_name}；请确认页面渲染完成后重录（若本条专门验收报错/空态，请在 --alt 中注明「错误/空态」）
gate5_media_guard.instructions_en: Inspect the attached UI acceptance screenshot/video frame. Is it a completely blank/solid screen (all white/black) or an unrendered browser crash/connection-refused page (`ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`, `502 Bad Gateway`, `Cannot GET /`) with no usable app UI?
gate5_media_guard.true_en: Pure blank/solid-color screen or browser/server crash page instead of real application UI.
gate5_media_guard.false_en: Shows rendered application UI, terminal output, dialog, form, or meaningful test content.

gate5_note_guard.title_zh: 评论正文暴露明文密码或密钥
gate5_note_guard.error_zh: Jev 检测到评论疑似包含明文密码或敏感密钥（置信度 {prob:.0%}），请移除凭据后再发
gate5_note_guard.instructions_en: Does this outgoing GitLab issue comment expose a real plaintext password, API secret key, access token, session cookie, or private key? (Ignore git commit SHAs, `/uploads/<hex>/...` URLs, issue/MR links, and normal usernames.)
gate5_note_guard.true_en: Contains a real plaintext password, API key/token, cookie, or private key.
gate5_note_guard.false_en: Safe engineering/product text, URLs, commit SHAs, or masked placeholders.

gate5_note_guard.title_zh: 长评论未在开头亮出结论或待办
gate5_note_guard.error_zh: 长评论未按「先说结论，再说细节」开头亮出结果或待用户决定事项；请把结论/待办提炼到前两句，将排查经过移入 `<details>` 折叠区后再发
gate5_note_guard.instructions_en: Read `visible_summary` (the outer comment text shown directly to a non-technical user before any `<details>` fold). Does it bury the main conclusion or required user decision at the bottom after long chronological debugging/investigation logs, instead of stating the conclusion or required action upfront in the opening 1-2 sentences?
gate5_note_guard.true_en: Starts with long step-by-step investigation/process logs and hides the conclusion or user action at the end.
gate5_note_guard.false_en: States the conclusion, answer, or required user action clearly right at the top (even if followed by structured tables/points).
